title: Tech-Tool Plastics releases new H135 windshields and nose bubbles
summary: The products are manufactured in-house, using the company's own precision tooling.
body_markdown:
Tech-Tool Plastics, Inc. has released new windshields and nose bubbles for the Airbus/Eurocopter EC135 and[H135](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/airbus/h135) helicopter family, built to the same standard of precision fit and durability that has defined the company’s windows for 50 years.


“I don’t usually have windows this clear,” said the test pilot after assessing Tech-Tool’s new[H135](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/airbus/h135) windshield.


## **Superior Optics**


Tech-Tool’s[H135](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/airbus/h135) windshields and nose bubbles, available for all EC135 and[H135](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/airbus/h135) models, are manufactured in-house using the company’s own precision tooling.


Every window holds a true, distortion-free shape from edge to edge. Tech-Tool’s proprietary technology yields optically superior windshields with no distortion, giving pilots a significantly cleaner sightline.


“Fifty years in, what we’re most proud of is that we keep showing up with the products operators actually need. There is a real gap in this market for EC135 windshields and nose bubbles that have easy availability and unrivalled clarity. That’s what drives us to keep expanding our product line, so every operator has access to windows they need when they need them,” said Tech-Tool Plastics President John Tracy Wilson.


Tech-Tool Plastics Photo


## **In Stock and Ready to Ship**


The new windshields and nose bubbles are currently in stock and ready to ship. Maintaining inventory levels for all of their products has been Tech-Tool’s long-standing priority, so when operators have a need they are quickly able to fill it.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by Tech-Tool Plastics.*
